prompt: Create a clean monochrome UI icon atlas for a native desktop Markdown notebook. Use the already selected quiet rounded monoline style: solid black ink on a perfectly plain white canvas, no shadows, gradients, texture, colour, words, letters, labels, borders, grids, badges or decoration. Landscape 3:2 sheet, exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, six equal square cells with generous identical margins. Each icon is centered in its own cell, has identical visual scale and a substantial uniform rounded stroke, equivalent to 2.2px at 24px. Shapes must remain clear at 18px UI size. Top row left to right: (1) GRAPH: four small hollow circular nodes joined by clean simple straight links, distinct network silhouette; (2) CANVAS: a rounded rectangular board containing two small blank cards connected by one short bent line, a clear visual canvas; (3) BOOKMARK: one simple vertical ribbon outline with an unmistakable V-notch at its bottom. Bottom row left to right: (4) DAILY NOTE: a small calendar outline with binding rings and one clear central sun symbol, minimal and legible; (5) TEMPLATES: two offset blank page outlines with a small inset rectangular text-area outline on the front page; (6) FILE RECOVERY: a simple clock outline with two hands and one counterclockwise curved return arrow around its upper-left edge. Black outlines with empty white counters, no fills except the necessary substantial ink strokes. Keep icons independent and separated; no element crosses a cell boundary. This is production UI artwork, not a presentation mockup.
selectionContext: Same approved rounded monochrome icon family as the existing generated Rust Notes assets. New distinct glyphs for explicit graph, canvas, bookmarks, daily notes, templates and recovery actions.
selectedRationale: Distinct network, board, ribbon, sun-calendar, page template and recovery-clock silhouettes; rounded monochrome contours match the approved existing family. Source inspected at full sheet size; native-size and source/SVG proof remain required.
verification: 48 source/SVG conditions inspected; native light/dark12/18/24/48px proof inspected; six pipeline regressions pass. Fine internal detail is intended for18px and larger.
